list.name: LoadId
list.query: select distinct LoadId from TestLoad order by LoadId desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia para operar tendencias enterprise, top consumidores, forecasts y frescura de evidencia.

options.content: Que muestra: performance, capacidad historica, top consumidores y forecast por host/servicio/dominio. Como interpretarlo: tendencias sostenidas y evidencia expirada elevan riesgo operativo. Accion sugerida: filtrar por lote y resolver primero saturacion, crecimiento y evidencia vencida.

panels.title: Top Consumers Enterprise
panels.description: Hosts con mayor consumo promedio y percentil alto por servicio y dominio.

targets.rawSql: select r.Name as HostName, c.DomainName, s.Name as BusinessService, k.MetricName, k.AverageUtilization, k.P95Utilization, k.PeakUtilization from CapacityKpi k join MonitoredResource r on r.ResourceId = k.ResourceId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = r.Name and c.LoadId = k.LoadId left join Service s on s.ServiceId = c.BusinessServiceId where k.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by k.P95Utilization desc limit 20

panels.title: Forecast 30 90 180 365
panels.description: Horizontes de forecast para decisiones de capacidad y fechas estimadas de agotamiento.

targets.rawSql: select r.Name as HostName, f.MetricName, f.Forecast30Days, f.Forecast90Days, f.Forecast180Days, f.Forecast365Days, f.DaysToSaturation from ForecastResult f join MonitoredResource r on r.ResourceId = f.ResourceId where f.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by f.DaysToSaturation asc

panels.title: Frescura de Evidencia
panels.description: Evidencia fresca, vencida, incompleta o faltante por host para evitar conclusiones sin soporte.

targets.rawSql: select c.ComponentName as HostName, e.SourceSystem, e.EvidenceType, e.FreshnessStatus, e.EvidenceState from EnterpriseEvidenceRecord e join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = e.ComponentId where e.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by e.FreshnessStatus, e.EvidenceState
